paper_id: Liu et al. - 2017 - An Improved Android Collusion Attack Detection Method Based on Program Slicing
title: An Improved Android Collusion Attack Detection Method Based on Program Slicing
motivation: Android collusion attacks让多个app协作泄露隐私，现有单app检测方法易被绕过
problem_framing: 现有污点分析仅关注赋值传播，忽略控制流导致的污染；且以app边界而非设备边界定义泄露
key_insight: 先用程序切片提取可疑路径缩小分析范围，再结合控制依赖和数据依赖做改进的污点分析
method_signature: 基于IACFG+程序切片+改进的到达定义分析检测跨应用隐私泄露
evaluation_criteria: 对比FlowDroid/IccTA/SCanDroid能否检测传统串通和基于控制流的串通攻击
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 无法分析native code、Web应用和动态链接库；因分析条件语句可能引入假阳性
evidence_for_taste: most exist methods ignore detection of taint propagation based on control flow
the sensitive data can circumvents traditional taint checking mechanism
It is difficult to analyze the source code for all existing tools
none of the tools found the collusion app group based on control flow
we neglect the false positive cause by analyzing conditional statements
thinking_moves: 从对抗角度构造攻击样本揭示现有工具的盲点
先用程序切片技术缩小分析范围再精细化污点追踪
将泄露边界从app级重新定义为device级以减少假阳性
extraction_notes: 论文格式完整但venue信息缺失，Table 2的标题标注有误(RQ3应为RQ2)。关键方法步骤有详细描述但部分伪代码显示为'some description'占位。
